misc.invite.title: Invitation to join the system
misc.invite.invalid: The invitation link is incomplete or was changed. Open the link in the invitation email again, or ask the administrator to send the invitation again.
misc.invite.body: You are invited to join a unit on the system. The invitation works once and is valid for 7 days. Only the invited email address can accept it.
misc.invite.signIn.hint: Sign in with the account that has the invited email address, then come back to this page to accept.
misc.invite.done: The invitation is accepted. Choose the unit to start working.
misc.invite.error.expired: The invitation has expired. Ask the administrator to send a new one.
misc.invite.error.email: The account signed in does not have the invited email address. Sign out and sign in with the right account.
misc.invite.error.quota: The unit has used all the seats of its plan. Ask the administrator to free a seat, then try again.
misc.invite.error.missing: This invitation was not found or has already been used.
misc.invite.error.session: The session has ended. Sign in again, then accept.
misc.invite.error.other: The invitation could not be accepted; try again.
misc.flag.off: The feature "{flag}" is not on for your unit: the actions on this screen are refused by the server until a release switches it on.
misc.flag.unknown: The release flags of the unit could not be read, so it is not known whether the feature of this screen is on.
misc.tpl.title: Draft a revision of a document template
misc.tpl.hint: A draft has no effect. Another person publishes it (the drafter does not publish their own), then a separate step confirms the legal basis.
misc.tpl.created: The draft of template {code} is saved. Another person publishes it in the table below.
misc.tpl.field.form.hint: The form code of the issuing body; two templates do not share a code.
misc.tpl.field.title: Template title (3 to 300 characters)
misc.tpl.field.blocks.hint: A JSON object describing the blocks of the document; leave {} when empty.
misc.tpl.field.placeholders.hint: A JSON object naming the type and requirement of each field filled into the document; the server checks this schema.
misc.tpl.field.legalRef.hint: Fill only when a confirming document exists; without it the template stays pending confirmation and carries a watermark.
misc.tpl.field.until.hint: Leave empty when there is no end day.
misc.tpl.field.watermark.hint: Shown on the issued copy while the template has no legal confirmation.
misc.tpl.layout.none: No layout is published yet: publish a page layout on the layout screen first.
misc.tpl.layout.error: The list of layouts could not be loaded.
misc.tpl.info.name: Effective period of the template
misc.tpl.info.formula: A revision applies from its start day to its end day, inclusive, if any; two revisions of one template code cannot overlap in time.
misc.tpl.problem.notObject: It must be a JSON object, for example {}.
misc.tpl.problem.beforeStart: The end day cannot be before the start day.
misc.tpl.refused.legal: The server wants a fuller legal basis for this template.
misc.tpl.refused.placeholders: The placeholder schema cannot be used. Fix the JSON and send again.
misc.tpl.refused.form: This form code is already used by another template. Use another code.
misc.tpl.refused.overlap: The effective period overlaps another revision of this template. Change the days.
misc.tpl.refused.invalid: The server refused what was entered. The fields keep their values so you can fix them.
misc.tpl.refused.denied: You do not have the right to draft document templates.
misc.tpl.refused.session: The session has ended. Sign in again, then send again.
misc.tpl.refused.other: The draft could not be saved; try again.
